visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long brown hair with purple highlights, wearing a white off-shoulder sweater and a grey plaid skirt, stands in front of a giant inflatable Pikachu. She smiles and points at the camera, then raises a Poké Ball as if throwing it. (2) The scene shifts to a wide shot of a large exhibition hall with red carpets and multiple booths. Staff in red shirts and various attendees are visible. The woman is seen from behind and the side as she walks through the venue. (3) The woman is at a gaming station with multiple Nintendo Switch consoles and large TV screens. She is seen playing the game, focusing on the screen which displays 3D Pokémon combat. (4) The woman poses and dances playfully on a stage area with two other people (one man and one woman) in front of a colorful Pokémon-themed backdrop. They make heart shapes with their hands. (5) A still graphic of the woman holding a small Pikachu plushie appears with decorative borders. (6) The woman stands in the middle of a group of four people, all holding Switch consoles and plushies, waving and gesturing enthusiastically toward the camera in a brightly lit indoor event space.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy female vocals exclaiming catchphrases immediately accompany a bright, upbeat synth-pop music track with a driving 4/4 beat. A sharp 'pop' SFX sounds as text appears on screen. (2) The female narrator's voice maintains a rapid, enthusiastic pace, detailing her experience at the event. The BGM remains steady with a melodic lead synth. (3) A subtle 'ding' SFX punctuates the transition as the narrator explains the Battle Club mode. Faint background room tone from the exhibition hall is audible behind the primary vocal track. (4) The narrator concludes with an energetic call to action, her pitch rising at the end of phrases. The music maintains its intensity through the end, ending with a final percussive hit.
